audit_metadata.task: SPECTRA Cohort Reconciliation & Scientific Evidence Gap Closure
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Independent Scientific Validation Lead & Software Integrity Auditor

p0008_calibration_cohort_3206_vs_7858.explanation: The actual physical calibration cohort on disk in spectra_p0008_calibration_scores_v1.csv contains exactly 3,206 clean isolated point sources (D1+D4: 1,055; D2+D5: 1,304; D3+D6: 847). The number 7,858 never existed in any Task 1.2A-1.2E report or dataset file; it was a clerical/hallucinatory transposition introduced in the Phase 3 Closeout prompt/summary.

blind_evaluation_cohort_9500_vs_1392.explanation: Both counts are real numbers from distinct project phases: 1,392 is the historical Phase 2 independent test set from Pointing 0003 (independent_test_assembled_spectra.csv). 9,500 is the authoritative Phase 3 multi-pointing blind evaluation cohort across Pointings 0002 (4,071), 0009 (2,284), and 0010 (3,145) in spectra_evaluation_scores_v1.csv. All 9,500 sources were evaluated in Phase 3.

earlier_extraction_count_6419.explanation: In Task 0, 6,419 evaluation sources and 11,883 SEDs were erroneously cited. Task 0R audited these and proved they originated from unrelated ASTROVISION scratch audits (scratch/audit11_out/) with zero provenance in SPECTRA artifacts. The true candidate evaluation count is 15,002, filtering to 9,500 clean sources.

leakage_audit_summary.historical_training_overlap_status: Five historical training overlaps (P0001, D1+D4) were explicitly isolated and purged during Task 1.2B-S; Pointing 0008 contains zero training overlaps.

blind_empirical_fpr_4_88_pct.actual_value: 6.32% global exceedance at T_0.05 (5.58% to 7.07% across strata)
blind_empirical_fpr_4_88_pct.provenance: 4.88% was an ASTROVISION Pointing 0010 FPR from Task 1.1T (pilot_evaluation_metrics.json), conflated into SPECTRA in Phase 3 closeout text.
blind_empirical_fpr_4_88_pct.scientific_classification: Empirical provisional-threshold exceedance rate on real uncurated sources (NOT verified ground-truth FPR).

median_null_recon_error_0_00035.actual_value: 0.36 to 0.45 physical masked-chi2 median (0.4237 in D1+D4, 0.3689 in D2+D5, 1.4255 in D3+D6)
median_null_recon_error_0_00035.provenance: 0.00035 was an un-normalized Phase 2 Task 3 Condition A metric on Pointing 0003 (5 ch). Phase 3 properly scales by systematic noise floor f_sys=0.0193.

mad_null_recon_error_0_00018.provenance: Historical Phase 2 scale parameter associated with Condition A, superseded by Phase 3 calibration distributions.

synthetic_injection_improvement_42_pct.actual_value: +21.7% relative AUROC gain (+0.1259 absolute; AUROC 0.7071 vs 0.5812 baseline)
synthetic_injection_improvement_42_pct.provenance: +42% was an ASTROVISION recovery metric conflated into SPECTRA text. True synthetic benchmark achieves AUROC 0.7071, AUPRC 0.8528, and 72.88% PAH recovery on 6,000 paired trials.

scientific_limitations_summary: Unconfirmed ground-truth null distribution: P0008 and P0002/P0009/P0010 lack ground-truth spectroscopic confirmation; real exceedance is not true FPR.
Selective sensitivity horizon: High recovery on narrow high-EW emission lines (72.88% PAH), but weak on smooth continuum variations (12.13% IR excess, 13.80% absorption troughs).
Detector stratum asymmetry: Stratum D3+D6 exhibits higher thermal background variance and wider uncertainties, depressing AUROC to 0.6790 vs >0.71 in D1+D4 and D2+D5.
Survey-wide generalization limitation: Validated across 4 pointings; unvalidated in crowded Galactic plane fields or high zodiacal gradient regimes.
recommended_next_scientific_task: Cross-match Pointing 0008 calibration sources with external spectroscopic surveys (SDSS, Gaia XP, LAMOST) to establish an authentic ground-truth normal stellar cohort, and integrate a dedicated photometric color-color sidecar for broadband continuum anomalies.
final_verdict_rationale: All historical cohort discrepancies (3,206 vs 7,858; 9,500 vs 1,392; 6,419 clerical error) and metric origins (4.88% FPR, 0.00035 median error, +42% gain) are 100% reconciled to their underlying physical files and provenance. Frozen artifacts are verified immutable. Zero leakage risk exists. However, because real field sources lack spectroscopic normality ground-truth, broad continuum recovery remains limited, and D3+D6 exhibits thermal noise deficit, the verdict is RECONCILED_WITH_LIMITATIONS.
